protocol.title: independent frozen-panel confirmation of the C2 weak-L2 precursor
protocol.status: checkpoint identities, mirrored rule, independent dataset, sample size, controls, and outcomes frozen before evaluation
protocol.hypothesis: The post-hoc weak-L2 scaffold in seed1879 is a reproducible out-of-sample property of the frozen C2 states rather than sampling noise or a generic weak-Memory signature. On a new N=4096 panel, the registered seed1879 step1400 and step1600 checkpoints will both pass the unchanged mirrored weak-L2 rule, while all nine default-L3 control checkpoints will fail that L2 rule.

selection_disclosure.seed1879_window: Steps1200-1800 and the candidate positives at steps1400/1600 were chosen after inspecting the Level 7.5.1 N=1024 panel; they are frozen before this independent panel.
selection_disclosure.default_controls: Three checkpoints per default seed bracket the previously observed L3 precursor transition. All nine are registered as L2-negative controls.
selection_disclosure.independence_claim: The evaluation examples are independent of Level 7.5.1. The training trajectories and frozen model checkpoints are not new independent initializations.

registered_mirrored_rules.strict_L2_core: formed behavior; whole-Memory causal; zero-L2 and roll-L2 <=0.20; keep-L2 >=0.90; zero-L1 and zero-L3 >=0.80; keep-L1 and keep-L3 <=0.20
registered_mirrored_rules.weak_L2_selective_precursor: not strict L2 core; intact >=0.20; minimum local >=0.90; reset-all, zero-all, and roll-all <=0.20; zero-L2 and roll-L2 <=0.20; keep-L2 >=0.20; keep-L1 and keep-L3 <=0.20; zero-L1 and zero-L3 each >=max(0.20,intact-0.05); keep-L2 minus max(keep-L1,keep-L3) >=0.10
registered_mirrored_rules.weak_L3_calibration: the identical weak rule with L2 and L3 exchanged
registered_mirrored_rules.classification_statistic: fixed point estimates at N=4096; confidence intervals are reported but do not replace or relax the frozen thresholds

registered_primary_test.independent_weak_L2_precursor_confirmed: both registered seed1879 positives pass the frozen weak-L2 rule and zero of nine default-L3 controls pass it
registered_primary_test.weak_L2_signal_not_route_specific: both registered seed1879 positives pass but one or more default-L3 controls also pass
registered_primary_test.weak_L2_precursor_partially_replicated: exactly one registered seed1879 positive passes
registered_primary_test.formal_integrity_failed_causal_interpret: a source or evaluation integrity condition fails

registered_secondary_outputs.seed1879_window: Report every weak-L2 positive step across the fixed step1200-1800 context window without changing the primary 2-of-2 rule.
registered_secondary_outputs.L3_calibration_role: A secondary sensitivity check that the independent panel redetects the known L3 precursor. It is not a hidden extra requirement for the L2 primary outcome.
registered_secondary_outputs.full_outputs: Report all sixteen condition metrics, Wilson intervals, rule component checks, and L2/L3 selectivity margins for all sixteen milestones.

protocol.scope: This is an independent evaluation-panel confirmation on frozen checkpoints, not an independent training replication. It tests whether the previously discovered weak-L2 signal generalizes to new examples and remains absent from matched default-L3 controls. It does not establish that the precursor causally directs later route choice.
protocol.stop_rule: Report the fixed N=4096 result and all registered alternatives. Do not alter the mirrored rule, add checkpoints, extend samples, or resume training.

diagnosis.registered_stop_boundary: Report the fixed N=4096 independent-panel result; do not alter the mirrored rule, add checkpoints, extend samples, or resume training.
